headline: Superintendent evaluation, union contract talks with the Educational Association of Worcester, and grants of $43,384.50 and $2,000.
summary: The meeting covers contract negotiations and the superintendent's evaluation. It also includes grants, prior year payments, donations, and four petitions from Ford on school placement, outside counsel, and cybersecurity.
items: Executive session: contract negotiations with the Educational Association of Worcester, Units A/B
Executive session: contract negotiations with the Educational Association of Worcester, Paraeducators Unit
Executive session: review of executive session minutes from the July 16, 2026 meeting
Consent agenda donations: Prospect Hill Academy Charter School, 953 Amplify Science Student Investigation Notebooks and print materials for grades first through fourth
Consent agenda donation: Blackstone Watershed Collaborative, forest management tools, supplies, and equipment for the Environmental Technology program at Worcester Technical High School
Consent agenda donation: Chacharone Properties, space at 220 Barber Avenue for temporary warehouse use
Consent agenda donation: Carnegie Hall Musical Explorers Digital, curriculum materials, professional development, and digital resources for grades K-2

Consent agenda cash donations to Worcester Technical High School in memory of Joseph Alfego: $50 (Patricia & Francis Magner), $150 (John Morocco & Telaine Dimatteo), $150 (Elizabeth Defalco & George Defalco Jr), $100 (Donald Speicher & Jill Ann Speicher), $25 (John Evans III & Paula Jeanne Evans), $50 (E Russell Young & Nancy Young), $100 (M. Pope & Co. Fine Jewelers)
Consent agenda: notification of new instructional staff, new non-instructional staff, and resignations/retirements
Consent agenda: initial filing of recognition and notices of interest to the district or public
Public comment

Petition c&p 6-10 (Ford): refer to committees and direct administration to provide an expedited, de-identified report on Nelson Place School placement and transfer decisions for 2026-2027; recommendation is to refer to administration

Petition c&p 6-11 (Ford): discuss and vote on directing administration to provide an expedited, public, de-identified report on Nelson Place School placement and transfer decisions for 2026-2027; recommendation is to refer to administration

Petition c&p 6-12 (Ford): discuss and vote on directing administration to provide a public, de-identified report on outside-counsel spending and the practice of involving outside counsel in administrative, educational, or pre-litigation matters; recommendation is to refer to administration

Petition c&p 6-13 (Ford): discuss and vote on directing administration to provide a public report and proposed corrective action on cybersecurity safeguards, security-incident response, and notification of affected school community members; recommendation is to refer to administration
Superintendent report: none, due to the superintendent evaluation
Grant: Community-Based Out of School Social and Recreational Program, $43,384.50
Grant: Replicating Applied Learning Everywhere (RALIE), $2,000
Approval of 27 prior year payments totaling $101,647.57
Prior year payment for missed educational level for a full year employee, $20,000
gb 6-88 (Petty): summative evaluation of the Superintendent for the 2025-2026 school year; recommendation is to approve and file
gb 6-89 (Clerk): review and approve School Committee meeting dates for calendar year 2027; recommendation is to approve and file
gb 6-90 (Administration): approve the Report of the Superintendent schedule for 2026-2027; recommendation is to approve and file
gb 6-91 (Mayor Petty): reschedule the November 5, 2026 meeting to November 12, 2026; recommendation is to approve and file

gb 6-92 (Biancheria): request that administration inquire about services through MassHire Worcester Career Center for students seeking jobs or internships; recommendation is to refer to administration
gb 6-93 (Administration): implement the new IRS mileage reimbursement rate, from $0.725 to $0.76 per mile, as of July 1, 2026; recommendation is to approve and file
location: Esther Howland Chamber, Worcester City Hall (also available virtually by Zoom)
